body: Verdict PASS rather than NEEDS_WORK. All six acceptance criteria re-verified green by independently running build/clippy/test/metadata/tree and byte-length stdout probes on all seven CLI paths including the three clap error paths. The defects found (IMPL_SUMMARY falsely claims .gitignore pre-existed when git show proves the commit created it; wrong line counts; scratch/verify_bootstrap.ps1 line 59 anchors its forbidden-dependency regex at ^ so it can never match cargo tree indented output) live in the summary and the scratch probe, not in shipped code. Named alternative rejected: NEEDS_WORK, which would force a fixer round for a documentation correction while the workspace itself meets every criterion.

Rejected the first independent stdout probe because this PowerShell/.NET exposed no usable ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList; arguments were omitted and each process exited 2, so those results do not verify subcommand behavior.

Verdict SHIP rather than NEEDS_FIXES. All six acceptance criteria re-verified from a cold cargo clean (build/test/clippy/fmt green, exactly two members and one bin via cargo metadata, nine CLI invocations measured byte-exact with zero stdout on every functional and clap-error path including RUST_LOG=trace and piped stdin, cargo tree -p transcript -e all free of tokio/HTTP/fs crates, all five gitignore patterns honoured, clean tree after rebuild). Disconfirmation experiment proved the new tests/stdout.rs is vacuous: a scratch copy of main.rs with .with_writer(std::io::stderr) deleted still passes the identical test, because tracing is declared but never invoked, and an added tracing::info! on the writer-less build put 64 bytes on stdout. Named alternative rejected: NEEDS_FIXES, which would force another fixer round over a guard's coverage gap while the shipped code is independently measured correct and the gap is cheap to close in TASK-003.
